title: Company Configuration Schema
description: Schema for company configurations in the Proformas-Empresas application

company_name.description: Full legal name of the company

payment_bcp_cci.description: CCI (Código de Cuenta Interbancaria) for BCP account

payment_bank_label.description: Label for bank account display (e.g., 'Cuenta en Soles BBVA')

offer_note_primary.description: Primary offer validity note (e.g., 'Validez de la oferta: 10 dias')

header_image.description: Path to header image asset (relative to static/assets/)

watermark_image.description: Path to watermark image asset (relative to static/assets/)
